{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows
top_rows = sales_df.head()

# Display basic info
info = sales_df.info()

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Display unique values in key columns
channel_unique = sales_df['channel'].unique()
segment_unique = sales_df['customer_segment'].unique()
conversion_unique = sales_df['converted'].unique()

# Return all
(top_rows, info, missing_values, duplicates, channel_unique, segment_unique, conversion_unique)"}
